dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったる……」
dialogues.en: "Hah...... What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "Hah...... What a pain......"

dialogues.jp:
こんなに心底“かったるい”と言ったことは、
初めてだ。
dialogues.en:
This was the first time I've ever felt truly exhausted to
the bottom of my heart.
dialogues.text:
This was the first time I've ever felt truly exhausted to
the bottom of my heart.

dialogues.jp:
今日は、萌先輩にフラれてから、初めての学園
だった……。
dialogues.en:
I was going to school for the first time after being dumped
by Moe-sempai......
dialogues.text:
I was going to school for the first time after being dumped
by Moe-sempai......

dialogues.jp:
サボろうかな、とも思ったが、今日だけ休んだ
ところで何の解決にもならない。それに萌先輩
に確かめてみたいことがある。
dialogues.en:
I thought about skipping today, but that wouldn't change
anything. I also wanted to ask Moe-sempai something.
dialogues.text:
I thought about skipping today, but that wouldn't change
anything. I also wanted to ask Moe-sempai something.

dialogues.jp: さくらが言っていた言葉……。
dialogues.en: I wanted to tell her what Sakura told me......
dialogues.text: I wanted to tell her what Sakura told me......

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 『お兄ちゃんの大事な人にも伝えてあげて』
dialogues.en: "You tell that to your special person."
dialogues.text: "You tell that to your special person."

dialogues.jp: あれはたぶん萌先輩のことだ。
dialogues.en: She was talking about Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: She was talking about Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
何を伝えればいいのかは分からないけど、もう
一度、萌先輩に会って話をしなければならない。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what I'm supposed to tell her, but I need to
see Moe-sempai one more time.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what I'm supposed to tell her, but I need to
see Moe-sempai one more time.

dialogues.jp: そんな気がする。
dialogues.en: That's how I felt.
dialogues.text: That's how I felt.

dialogues.jp: 「覚悟を決めるか……」
dialogues.en: "I have to be ready......"
dialogues.text: "I have to be ready......"

dialogues.jp:
いつまでも家の前で｛うな／唸｝っていても、ご近所の井
戸端会議の議題にされるだけだ。
dialogues.en:
I can't just stay in front of my house. I'll be nothing but
a pathetic topic for gossip in the neighborhood.
dialogues.text:
I can't just stay in front of my house. I'll be nothing but
a pathetic topic for gossip in the neighborhood.

dialogues.jp:
勢い良く家の前の道路に出ると、学園へと歩き
だした。
dialogues.en:
I went out into the street and started heading toward
school.
dialogues.text:
I went out into the street and started heading toward
school.

dialogues.jp: 「すー、はぁ……」

廊下で深呼吸をして、ゴクリと唾を飲み込み、
萌先輩の教室を覗く。
dialogues.en:
I took a deep breath in the hallway and swallowed. Then I
looked inside Moe-sempai's classroom.
dialogues.text:
I took a deep breath in the hallway and swallowed. Then I
looked inside Moe-sempai's classroom.

dialogues.jp: ざっと中を見渡すが先輩の姿はない。
dialogues.en: I looked around, but I didn't see her.
dialogues.text: I looked around, but I didn't see her.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……水越先輩いますか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Is Moe Mizukoshi-sempai in here?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Is Moe Mizukoshi-sempai in here?"

dialogues.jp:
側にいた生徒に尋ねるが、まだ来てないと言わ
れる。
dialogues.en:
I asked one of her classmates, but I was told that she's
still not here.
dialogues.text:
I asked one of her classmates, but I was told that she's
still not here.

dialogues.jp: （仕方ない……ここで待つか……）
dialogues.en: (Oh well...... I'll just wait here......)
dialogues.text: (Oh well...... I'll just wait here......)

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと居心地は悪かったが、教室の前で萌先
輩がやってくるのを待つ。
dialogues.en:
I didn't feel comfortable, but I decided to wait for her in
the front of her classroom.
dialogues.text:
I didn't feel comfortable, but I decided to wait for her in
the front of her classroom.

dialogues.jp: キーンコーンカーンコーン。
dialogues.en: Ding Dong......
dialogues.text: Ding Dong......

dialogues.jp: 「やばっ……」
萌先輩は来てないが仕方ない……。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai isn't here, but I have no choice......
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai isn't here, but I have no choice......

dialogues.jp:
また休み時間にでも来よう。たぶん、遅刻――
あるいは大遅刻か……。
dialogues.en:
I'll come here again during the break. She'll probably be
late......
dialogues.text:
I'll come here again during the break. She'll probably be
late......

dialogues.jp: 教室の前を離れ、階段に向かう。
dialogues.en: I went away from her classroom and headed toward the stairs.
dialogues.text: I went away from her classroom and headed toward the stairs.

dialogues.jp:
『廊下は走らないように』という注意書きの前
を一瞬で通り過ぎ、自分の教室に急いだ。
dialogues.en:
I hurried to my classroom, dashing in front of the sign that
said "Do not run in the hallway.".
dialogues.text:
I hurried to my classroom, dashing in front of the sign that
said "Do not run in the hallway.".

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩に会いたい◆
dialogues.en: ◆I want to see Moe-sempai◆
dialogues.text: ◆I want to see Moe-sempai◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩に会うために、学園に向かった。
dialogues.en: I went to school in order to see Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I went to school in order to see Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: けれど、会えなかった。
dialogues.en: However, I couldn't see her.
dialogues.text: However, I couldn't see her.
